text:
maria: Quick follow-up from last night's postmortem. Pattern is repeating: cloud transient -> auth token surge -> model-registry timeouts -> brief customer errors. We need a durable owner map, dates, and a simple recurring check-in. Who volunteers to stitch this together? :hand:
aj: I can spin up a remediation tracker and manage owner rotations. I'll make a lightweight sheet with owner, priority, status, and SLA mapping. Can someone pull a 90-day vendor-filtered incident export for me? :file_folder:
liam: I'll grab the logs + alerts and produce a vendor-by-week heatmap. Will include peak times and correlation with deploys. ETA: EOD today.
sre_lead: Important: audit circuit-breaker thresholds and autoscaler backoff. If provider errors spike, our current CBs may not fire fast enough and cause cascading retries. Add a column in the tracker for "failure mode" (auth/registry/infra) and "short-term mitigation".
kate: I'll audit runbooks vs. actual failures and call out gaps (model-registry token jitter, cross-region retry logic missing). Draft runbook patches by Tue AM.
security: I'll validate KMS rotation windows and token TTLs. There are signs that synchronized rotations could produce auth load spikes. If so, we should add jitter and stagger rotations. Report by Monday.
aj: Action list — please ack and claim:
- AJ: create remediation tracker (sheet + owner tags + status) — due 2026-04-15
- LIAM: vendor heatmap + 90d incident extracts — due 2026-04-13
- KATE: runbook gap doc + patch proposals — due 2026-04-14
- SECURITY: KMS/token rotation review & jitter proposal — due 2026-04-13
- SRE_LEAD: circuit-breaker & autoscaler config review — due 2026-04-16
- TEAM: propose monthly dependency failover drill (synthetic traffic) — proposal due 2026-04-20
React with :white_check_mark: if you own an item.
liam: ack. Will attach the query and a small script. Example commands I'll use:
```
journalctl -u svc-model-registry | grep -E "(timeout|401|503)" | awk '{print $1,$2,$3,$NF}' > /tmp/registry-errors.log
python tools/heatmap.py /tmp/registry-errors.log --window 1d --vendor model-registry
```
I'll link the output in the tracker.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-0413-07 linked; creating tracker item DEC-2026-0413-01 assigned to AJ.
sre_lead: Two short-term mitigations to evaluate:
1) Per-route fallback to a cached model snapshot (v1-small) for short windows when registry latency > 200ms.
2) Synthetic canary that runs every 12 hours validating failover behavior and surface any drift to the console.
Fallback rule prototype for router config:
```
if registry_latency_ms > 200 and error_rate > 0.02:
  route -> cached_snapshot:v1-small
  notify -> #incidents
```
kate: For the drill, propose a scoped scenario "auth-provider burst" where we simulate 500s on token endpoint and measure MTTR to fallback, alert coverage, and user-facing error delta. Recording metrics: time-to-fallback, error-rate delta, and cost impact. I'll draft the drill runbook and checklist.
security: Also adding vendor SLA mapping (what's covered/excluded) to the tracker. Many SLAs exclude transient auth hiccups; we need playbook actions tied to contract commitments.
aj: Let's add a recurring calendar item "dependency resilience review" and rotate owners monthly. Who wants to be on-call for the first rotation? Reply here.
maria: Thanks. Two quick asks before close:
- Put postmortem link in the tracker
- Mark any infra fallback work as blocker/high priority
- Confirm sync next Wed 09:00 to review heatmap + tracker
I'll create the calendar invite and agenda (heatmap, runbook gaps, drill schedule). :calendar:
aj: I'll post the tracker link here by EOD and assign owners. Planning to finish initial assignments by EOD tomorrow.
maria: ack. Leaving thread open for updates through Monday. If blocked, tag @maria or @aj. :eyes:
